summary: CI guard: fail if corpus-schema.sql diverges from pipeline published hash, or documented diff gate in deploy runbook

resolution.note: Committed schema/corpus-schema.sql.sha256 (the v3/pipeline hash) + a CI step 'Corpus schema integrity' running sha256sum -c, failing fast on any local drift. Header documents the lockstep: re-mirror + regenerate the checksum together when the pipeline bumps the schema. Verified sha256sum -c passes locally.
